apikey.description: Pilvio platform API key. Can be obtained from the https://app.pilvio.com web UI.

name.description:
Name of the bucket, rules for bucket names: 
	* name must be unique
	* name must be between 3 and 63 characters long
	* must not contain uppercase characters or underscores
	* must start with a lowercase letter or number
